notes: The opening *When* answers to no morpheme — the Hebrew juxtaposes `הֵמָּה עִם־בֵּית מִיכָה` — so it is `added` under rule 55, and the waw of `וְהֵמָּה`, standing at the head of the second clause rather than before the *When*, is unrepresented under rule 14.
`נַעַר` → *young man* is headed on *young* by rule 31's subtraction test; *man* is the defensible alternative and is named.
`מַה־לְּךָ פֹה` → *what hast thou here* is rule 43's verbless possessive: *hast* on the `לְ`, *thou* on its suffix.
